messages:
Olivia Chen: Heads-up: starting migration of external API keys (legacy token) into the new consent-first flow. Want to surface a few risky cases around quotas & attribution. PTAL.
Dan R.: Are we forcing rotation or supporting dual auth during rollout?
Olivia Chen: Dual for 2 weeks, rotation optional but recommended. console will show 'migrate' CTA + warning. Need mapping for billing attribution when tokens cross org/project boundaries.
maria-product: Question: When a legacy key is exchanged for delegated token, which entity gets quota? Original project or the service account? We need to keep billing predictable.
Akshay Patel: Current plan: preserve original project attribution by default, add `origin_project` field on token exchange trace. But if user opts into 'delegate to SA', we shift attribution.
Jamie Liu: Shifting attribution will break existing dashboards. We should flag it and provide migration report with expected delta.
Olivia Chen: Agreed. Also need telemetry events for `exchange_reason` + `migration_flag`. We'll need an opt-in bucket for canary.
infra-bot: Canary group created: 450 orgs. Policy: dual-auth enabled. ETA: today 17:30 UTC.
Dan R.: Impl detail: be careful with quota enforcement path. If we accept delegated token but keep attribution, the quota check must read origin header and service account tag. sketch:
```
if token.type == "delegated" and token.origin_project:
    billing_key = token.origin_project
else:
    billing_key = token.project
```
Akshay Patel: Edge: third-party connectors that rely on token-to-service mapping may expect SA-level quotas. We should expose a console toggle per org.
Olivia Chen: Console toggle is must-have. Flow: Admins see migration dashboard, sample traffic, predicted quota delta, and a 'shift attribution' toggle + apply. Also a rollback button.
Jamie Liu: Can we compute expected token reusage that might spike unit costs? Need an estimator.
Dan R.: I'll add an endpoint `/internal/migration/estimate?org=...` that returns CSV of projected delta. Example response:
```
{"org":"acme","current_month_tokens":1234567,"projected_tokens_post_shift":1523000,"delta":288433}
```
maria-product: UX copy: 'Migrate your legacy keys to the new consent flow. You can keep billing attribution with your current project or delegate to service accounts. Consult the migration report before shifting.'
Olivia Chen: Also: rotation plan for keys older than 90 days — force rotate via admin unless org opted out.
SRE-Alex: Ops note: rotation will cause ephemeral spikes in request rates. Plan a rate-smoothing window + alerts. I'll add an oncall playbook.
deploy-bot: Deployment: migration service v2 rolled out to canary. Commit: abc123. Status: success.
Olivia Chen: Thanks. Next steps: Dan add estimate endpoint + console toggle flag; Akshay add `origin_project` propagation in token exchange; Jamie prepare migration report UI mock; Alex add playbook. I'll sync tomorrow 11am.
Akshay Patel: :thumbsup: will start.
Dan R.: :thumbsup: ETA EOD
